name: Tatarime Mizuha
source:
Mizuha is a chuunibyou, but who wouldn’t be one when you got a surname that sounds like “cursed eyes”? Likewise, she believes to be possessed by the Death God “Gouma”, from who she claims to have received the “death-touch” and the power to see visions of future deaths. Those powers are supposed to manifests in her right eye and right hand, which she hides with an eye-patch for medical use and some bandages. By taking those off, it’s revealed she uses a colored contact-lens and some doodles she did with a magic pencil. The first and last time she meets with the protagonist is when she was performing a ritual to get rid of Gouma, ON HIS TEMPLE! She lit a huge bonfire and screamed a bunch of gibberish during the night, which made easier for them to call the police on her, and that was it for her… 

However, in an alternative timeline, Haruto decides to take on the matter himself by pretending to exorcise Gouma from her and charging money for the job. Unfortunately, Haruto’s plan backfires on him when Mizuha falls in love with him for how cool and mystical he was during the ritual and begs to become his disciple.

[From [url=http://otakuoverdrive.com/2014/11/18/galge-review-doushite-sonna-ni-kuroi-kami-ga-suki-na-no/]gangrelion's review[/url]]
translation:
水羽是个中二病，但姓氏听起来像“诅咒之眼”，谁不会中二呢？她相信自己被死神“劫魔”附身，自称从对方那里得到“死触”以及看见未来死亡的能力。她认为这些力量显现在右眼和右手上，因此用医用眼罩和绷带遮住。取下后才发现，她使用的是彩色隐形眼镜，右手的图案也是用魔法笔画的涂鸦。她第一次、也是最后一次与主人公见面时，正在他的神社里举行驱除劫魔的仪式！她夜里点燃巨大篝火，尖叫一堆胡话，让他们更容易报警；这便是她的结局……

然而，在另一条时间线中，春人决定亲自处理此事，假装驱除她体内的劫魔并收取费用。不幸的是，春人的计划适得其反：水羽因他仪式中的帅气神秘而爱上他，恳求成为他的弟子。

[来源：[url=http://otakuoverdrive.com/2014/11/18/galge-review-doushite-sonna-ni-kuroi-kami-ga-suki-na-no/]gangrelion的评论[/url]]
